audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4, 5 and 6 read Vayne/Skill/Vayne while this page's own whys say Level 6 is a coin-flip, the first item favours Jax, and two-plus items favour Jax.
audit.why: whys[4] 'Level 6 is a coin-flip', whys[5] 'First item favours Jax', whys[6] 'Two-plus items favour Jax' — and spikes[2]/spikes[3] say the same. The packet chart agrees: Vayne x4, Skill, Jax, Jax. A carryRating of 10/10 with the last two rows given to Vayne is not defensible. I have NOT touched rows 0-3, which already read Vayne and match both the packet and the prose.
audit.corrected: Rows 4, 5, 6 to Skill, Jax, Jax as matched pairs with ratings and the three phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item and two-item phase whys still described Vayne spiking, contradicting the corrected rows.
audit.why: Jax's item spike (Trinity Force or Blade of the Ruined King) plus Grandmaster's Might resistances arrives before Vayne's second item does anything about it. Leap Strike is 8s at rank 1 falling to 6s, so the punish window between his gap-closes is short.
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].why rewritten around the real spike order and the 6-8s Leap Strike gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the do's and don'ts, and Counter Strike's dodge was never described as what it actually is.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges all incoming attacks for its duration and then stuns — 300 range, 17s at rank 1 falling to 9s. The correct play is to stop attacking during it, not to walk away, because your autos are what it eats. Leap Strike is 700 range on 8s falling to 6s; Empower is 300 range on 7s falling to 3s and is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up on his weapon is the tell for the burst, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the stop-autoing rule written into the do's and don'ts.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Land Counter Strike' as a probable wrong name — false positive, correct E name with a verb in front. The mirror already renamed the ult to Grandmaster's Might in the content layer and it reads correctly here.

notes: MIRROR CONFLICT, deliberately not resolved by me. The jax__vayne audit reports its corrected chart as Skill, Jax, Jax, Skill, Jax, Skill, Vayne — i.e. Jax winning Levels 2-3 and VAYNE winning the two-item stage. That contradicts the packet chart (Vayne x4, Skill, Jax, Jax), this page's own whys and spikes in every one of those rows, and a Jax carryRating of 10/10. I corrected only rows 4-6, where the packet and this file's own prose agree with each other, and left rows 0-3 (already Vayne) untouched. If mirror-fix.js is run it will overwrite rows 4-6 with the Jax-side values and the page will then disagree with its own whys[5]/whys[6] text, so this needs a human call before that runs. Also carried over from the mirror and still unverified: the repeated claim elsewhere on Vayne pages that Condemn 'cancels Leap Strike outright' — Condemn is a knockback and the kits contain no dash-interrupt data, so I neither asserted nor removed it.
